title: GraphEdit's zoom_step can be incorrectly set to values less than 1.0
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8228) - AMD FX(tm)-6300 Six-Core Processor (6 threads) - 15.98 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The `zoom_step` property of a `GraphEdit` can incorrectly be set to values less than 1.0. An error will be produced when doing so, but the `GraphEdit` will still see the new zoom step as valid and use it. 

When the zoom step is below 1.0, zoom is miscalculated and visual errors occur (eg. the graph will zoom in when you try and zoom out).

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a `GraphEdit`
- Set the `zoom_step` to something below 1.0 but above 0.0 (This will produce an error, but won't revert to the previous value)
- Try zooming in or out with the `Graph Edit` menu buttons (the `zoom_step` variable is only used for those)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[graph-edit-zoom-step.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29531128/graph-edit-zoom-step.zip)
